messages.author: ccf9bdb6b0f7e9b9
messages.subject: Installation on a Linux ppc64le machine
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to install R-INLA on an HPC cluster operating an old (8-9 years) Linux system with a ppc64le architecture and it seems that this architecture is not supported by the binaries distributed.

Loading the INLA library works fine

> library(INLA)
Loading required package: Matrix
Loading required package: sp
Loading required package: parallel
Loading required package: foreach
This is INLA_20.03.17 built 2020-11-12 08:51:11 UTC.
See www.r-inla.org/contact-us for how to get help.
To enable PARDISO sparse library; see inla.pardiso()

but then when I run this example code

INLA:::inla.dynload.workaround()

n = 100; a = 1; b = 1; tau = 100
z = rnorm(n)
eta = a + b*z

scale = exp(rnorm(n))
prec = scale*tau
y = rnorm(n, mean = eta, sd = 1/sqrt(prec))


data = list(y=y, z=z)
formula = y ~ 1+z
result = inla(formula, family = "gaussian", data = data)

I get this error

FATAL: kernel too old
sh: line 1: 30931 Aborted                 '/.statelite/tmpfs/gpfs/projects/bsc32/software/suselinux/11/software/R/3.6.2-foss-2019b/lib64/R/library/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.static' -b -s -v -t 16 '/.statelite/tmpfs/scratch/tmp/RtmpL8fW9v/file786e773cf503/Model.ini' > '/.statelite/tmpfs/scratch/tmp/RtmpL8fW9v/file786e773cf503/Logfile.txt'

Is there any workaround to this?

Many thanks,

Giulia

parts:
suselinux 11 is pretty old...

can you try to make sense of this

hrue.r-inla-download.org/build64.tgz

edit GNUmakefile

make taucs
make amd
make muparser

for later versions, I set like

export INLA_TAG=Version_20.10.12-1

and

make download
make update

and you find the binaries in

local/bin/inla inla.mkl and fmesher

the PARDISO library will likely not work with your system, and you have
compile with

-DNO_PARDISO_LIB

and include inlaprog/src/libpardiso.o in the link line for inla


Best
H
